axial_encoder: torchvision ResNet18 IMAGENET1K_V1; frozen; fc=Identity; 512 features per 2.5D slice
axial_preprocessing: All Axial T2 series in a study. Per-series 1st/99th percentile intensity scaling; previous/current/next nearby, similarly oriented slices form RGB-like channels; full field resized to 224x224 and ImageNet normalized. No reference-coordinate cropping.
coordinate_frames: Compare physical positions only within a common nonempty FrameOfReferenceUID; missing frame IDs isolate a series. Different frames form separate coordinate groups, ordered by minimum series_id, and are pooled as a set without assuming registration. Real pre-training metadata QC found different frame IDs in all 83 available multi-series studies checked; do not discard all such studies or compare their unregistered z coordinates.
slice_selection: All slices if N<=96; otherwise 96 uniformly spaced indices in deterministic frame-group order and cranial-to-caudal order within each group. Fixed without labels.
attention: Linear(514,64),Tanh,Linear(64,2); masked softmax over slices separately for L4-L5 and L5-S1; weighted mean of slice features
sagittal_head: Linear(514,64),ReLU,Dropout(0.2),Linear(64,3); 512 frozen SpineNet features plus level one-hot
fusion_head: Linear(1026,64),ReLU,Dropout(0.2),Linear(64,3); sagittal and axial concatenation plus level one-hot
class_weights: Inverse square root of fitting-set class counts on common assessed targets, normalized to mean 1
standardization_scope: Separate sagittal/axial channel means and standard deviations fitted only on fitting-fold TRAIN patients; all TRAIN for final refit. No held-fold or validation fit. Fixed-position channels remain in [0,1].
folds: Reuse original TRAIN study grouping from head-v2; both levels and all axial series of a patient remain in one fold
comparison_population: Same requested patients and levels for all variants. Train and compare classification on common complete sagittal+axial targets; separately report availability by modality and every failure. No missing prediction becomes normal.
epoch_selection: Each CV seed selects the earliest epoch with strictly highest held-fold macro-F1, patience 7. Final epoch count is median of its three fold selections; refit on full original TRAIN, then evaluate original validation once.
ensemble: Equal mean of probability vectors from all three seeds; no tuned weights or thresholds
primary_metric: Macro-F1 on identical commonly assessed targets, labels [0,1,2]
secondary_metrics: severe recall and severe to normal/mild errors
all seed scores and uniform ensemble

bootstrap.unit: study_id; both levels and failures together
bootstrap.interval: Paired percentile 95% interval using the same study resamples

test_policy: Do not load original TEST images or features. Original validation has informed prior development, so v3 validation and early-stopped CV are development estimates, not a new independent confirmation. No post-result hyperparameter changes in this protocol.
interpretation: Tests this lightweight frozen-encoder attention implementation, not the maximum possible benefit of axial MRI. Axial features use ImageNet pretraining; sagittal features use medical SpineNet pretraining. Encoder architecture and pretraining differ. Expert review of axial attention is pending.
